decision.basis: no registered rule compares these eligible candidates; they are unranked, not equally accurate

reasons: reference_is_silver_and_partly_circular: The ACONF12 reference is a 'silver' standard (canonical MP2-F12 plus a CCSD(F12*) and (T) correction) and is the only independent comparison; the ACONF16 and ACONF20 reference is canonical MP2-F12/CBS plus the [LNO-CCSD(T) - LMP2]/vTight/AV{Q,5}Z correction (HLC14), whose localized-orbital part is the same calculation one preferred protocol is, so that protocol's agreement with the reference on those two subsets (MAD 0.06 and 0.09 kcal/mol, against 0.05 on ACONF12) shares a component with the reference and is not independent evidence. The rule can lean only on the 12 ACONF12 conformers of one molecule.

no_numeric_reference_uncertainty: The article states no numeric uncertainty for the reference energies. It says only that the three best LNO variants are 'indistinguishable' given the statistical uncertainty, and that the revision moved conformer energies by up to +0.60/-0.67 kcal/mol (MAD 0.31 between old and new references). A mean absolute deviation of 0.04-0.07 kcal/mol is below that scale, so no ordering among the preferred variants can be stated and the margin of the coarse claim against the reference uncertainty is not quantified.

mad_is_not_a_per_conformer_error: Every figure is a mean absolute deviation over a set (RMSD and MSD also given). None is an error bar for one conformer's relative energy, and the benchmark cannot be turned into an uncertainty on a stored value.

core_correlation_and_corrections_not_stated: The text read states neither the frozen-core or all-electron treatment nor whether the conformer energies contain zero-point or thermal contributions (the numbers behave as fixed-geometry electronic energies). The actual-protocol facts core_treatment and included_corrections that a cohort needs would have to be read from the datasets.

geometry_level_not_stated: The conformer geometries are 'extracted from ref 24'; the level at which they were optimised is not stated in this article, so the geometry facts a cohort needs cannot be established from it.

relative_energy_is_not_a_supported_quantity: TCKDB's structure selection compares an electronic energy or a zero-kelvin energy. A relative conformer energy against a named reference conformer (which is the all-trans conformer for two sets and the hairpin for the third, and is not the lowest conformer for n-hexadecane, where conformer 00 is 0.49 kcal/mol lower) is a derived quantity with no intent of its own yet. Until one exists the rule's observable never matches and it cannot make an edge.

localized_orbital_settings_need_vocabulary: The actual-protocol declaration can carry local_correlation and pair_natural_orbital approximations with a free setting, but the LNO accuracy threshold, the extrapolation exponents, the (T) treatment and the program-specific meaning of 'Tight' are not typed; the same threshold name in MRCC, ORCA and Molpro is not the same approximation.

domain_is_three_molecules: The evidence is the conformer sets of three n-alkanes. Nothing in the article supports a statement for other alkanes, branched or functionalised molecules, other conformer counts or other geometries.

rules.proposed_statement: For relative conformer energies (against the named reference conformer of each set) of the 12, 16 and 20 conformers of n-dodecane, n-hexadecane and n-icosane of the revised ACONFL dataset, LNO-CCSD(T) at the Tight or vTight threshold with an aug-cc-pV{Q,5}Z extrapolation (or vTight with aug-cc-pV5Z) is preferred over LNO-CCSD(T) with aug-cc-pVTZ at any threshold (Normal, Tight, vTight or vvTight), on the objective of expected accuracy as measured by the paper's mean absolute deviation against its own reference. Only the coarse separation (a mean absolute deviation of about 0.04-0.07 against about 0.7-0.95 kcal/mol) is stated; the three preferred variants are not ordered among themselves.

preferred: LNO-CCSD(T) (MRCC 2022), threshold Tight, aug-cc-pV{Q,5}Z two-point extrapolation (exponent 3.0), JKfit and aug-cc-pVnZ-RI fitting bases
LNO-CCSD(T) (MRCC 2022), threshold vTight, aug-cc-pV{Q,5}Z two-point extrapolation (exponent 3.0), JKfit and aug-cc-pVnZ-RI fitting bases
LNO-CCSD(T) (MRCC 2022), threshold vTight, aug-cc-pV5Z, JKfit and aug-cc-pVnZ-RI fitting bases
yielding: LNO-CCSD(T) (MRCC 2022), any other threshold (Normal, Tight, vTight or vvTight) at aug-cc-pVTZ, JKfit and aug-cc-pVnZ-RI fitting bases

required_predicates: The request is a relative conformer energy over one named conformer set, with the reference conformer named, and covers every member of the set (no mixed-method profile is built from each member's available method).
The conformer set is the ACONF12, ACONF16 or ACONF20 set of the revised ACONFL dataset, identified by member, not by the molecule's name alone.

Each candidate protocol states its program and version, the LNO threshold, the basis sets and the extrapolation, the density fitting, and the frozen-core or all-electron treatment, all established (none inferred from a label).
Both candidates use the same geometries, taken from the same source.
The objective is expected accuracy (a benchmark statement), never model fidelity and never a per-conformer error bar.

A tighter keyword (a tighter cutoff, a larger grid, a bigger basis) is not evidence of accuracy by itself, and the declared numerical approximations are descriptions, not demonstrated errors.
The rule is not approved by the owner and its predicates are not implemented or reviewed.

rules.citation: No source. The council's proposed rule form (council rationale of 2026-10-04, section 3: "Controlled convergence on one fixed model"): "a demonstrably resolved result can be preferred to a demonstrably inaccurate approximation for a declared numerical-fidelity objective". The council says this is a proposed form, not a rule from merely tighter keyword spelling.
rules.council_observation: A proposed rule form with no primary-source comparison. The council's own conditions are that the comparison and the reference are pinned and that the error resolution is demonstrated; tighter keywords, more basis functions, more attachments or lower absolute totals alone create no edge.

evidence_needed.items: the reference calculation, the settings compared, the error of each against the reference with its uncertainty, and the domain
evidence_needed.source: a specific primary source or dataset that pins a reference and demonstrates the error resolution for a named numerical setting

evidence_needed.items: whether a recorded reference comparison belongs in the declaration vocabulary at all

exceptions: A comparison with no pinned reference, or in which the reference's own resolution is not stated.
Any difference between candidates other than the one numerical setting.
inactive_reasons: no_source: There is no primary source, dataset or comparison behind this form. It is a council proposal, so there is no scope, no reliability and no uncertainty to pin.

no_pinned_reference_in_the_store: TCKDB stores no pinned reference calculation against which a candidate's error could be established, and the structure declarations have no field for a recorded reference comparison.

setting_names_do_not_imply_accuracy: A tighter keyword (a tighter cutoff, a larger grid, a bigger basis) is not evidence of accuracy by itself, and the declared numerical approximations are descriptions, not demonstrated errors.
owner_acceptance_and_predicates: The rule is not approved by the owner and its predicates are not implemented or reviewed.
not approved for activation by the owner
the rule's predicates are not implemented
rules.interpretation: Not applied: no comparison is made until the owner signs the manifest entry and the predicates exist.
rules.proposed_statement: For one fixed model chemistry at one geometry, a calculation shown against a pinned reference to be resolved to a stated error is preferred over one shown against the same reference to be inaccurate by more than that error, on the objective of model fidelity to that pinned reference. No statement about any specific method, basis or setting is made.

preferred: a result shown, against a pinned reference calculation of the same model, to be resolved to a stated error
yielding: a result shown, against the same pinned reference, to be inaccurate by more than that error

required_predicates: The two candidates differ only in a numerical setting of one fixed model.
The request names the pinned reference model (reference_model) and the error resolution it is judged against.
The error of each candidate against the reference is established by a recorded comparison, not by the setting's name.

scope.observable: electronic energy (or zero-kelvin energy) of one fixed model chemistry, at one geometry
scope.state_and_geometry: one fixed geometry and one fixed model; the two candidates differ only in a numerical setting

decision.search_completeness: coverage is the caller's authorized population only; it proves neither a corpus-wide best nor an exhaustive conformational search

integrity.note: sha256 checksums over the canonical JSON of each normalised input and of the whole manifest; they detect edits and are not signatures: anyone who edits a manifest can recompute them
